Subject: New vendor onboarding: Aurora Systems — insurance and PO questions

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier. As requested, I'm starting the onboarding thread and attaching our current Certificate of Insurance and W9 for Redwood's intake. A quick summary of what we have attached: COI (primary limits), signed W9.

A couple quick questions to help coordinate on our side:
- Will Redwood require an Additional Insured endorsement and waiver of subrogation for this engagement? If so, can you confirm the exact wording and any mailbox or reference that needs to be listed on the endorsement?
- What is the expected timeline for PO issuance once risk signs off? We have internal milestones that hinge on receiving a PO.

I've attached the two docs here: COI_Aurora_2028.pdf, W9_Aurora.pdf. If your risk team needs carrier contact info to issue endorsement paperwork, let me know and I'll loop them in.

Best,

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding: Aurora Systems — insurance and PO questions

Hi Liam — thanks for sending these over and for the call. Sharing a few notes from procurement/risk side so we can move efficiently: 

1) Coverage expectations (Redwood standard):
   - Commercial general liability: $1,000,000 per occurrence / $2,000,000 aggregate
   - Professional liability/Errors & Omissions: $1,000,000 (if scope includes professional services)
   - Cyber liability: $1,000,000 (if handling customer data)

2) Endorsement: yes, we typically require an Additional Insured endorsement (CG 20 10 or equivalent) naming "Redwood Inference, Inc." and a waiver of subrogation where applicable. Please request the insurer issue an endorsement form that lists: 
   - "Redwood Inference, Inc. and its subsidiaries and affiliates; 150 Bryant St, San Francisco, CA"

3) PO timing: once Risk confirms the endorsement and we have a final invoice/statement of work, Finance can issue a PO. Typical window is 2–5 business days after endorsement is on file; if an immediate conditional PO is needed we can ask Finance to open a provisional PO pending receipt of the final endorsement.

Could you confirm whether the engagement includes handling any customer PII (so we can confirm cyber limits)? If you can get the carrier to produce the endorsement, please send it to this thread and upload to the Drive link below. I'll shepherd to Finance for PO creation.

Drive folder for onboarding docs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAuroraOnboarding

Thanks — Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
